title: Our Courses
subtitle: Personalized tutoring programs for each student
overview: Yumetoki Commercial Co., Ltd. offers a wide range of educational programs for students from elementary school to high school, university students, and working professionals. Each course is customized to the individual needs and learning styles of the students, maximizing learning efficiency through one-on-one tutoring.

elementary.title: Elementary School
elementary.description: Emphasizes improving basic academic skills and establishing learning habits in a fun and engaging environment.

junior.title: Junior High School
junior.description: Focuses on preparing for the Basic Competence Test and improving school grades with systematic learning support.

high.title: High School
high.description: Supports university entrance exam preparation and advanced learning skills acquisition for future careers.

adult.title: University & Adults
adult.description: Supports learning according to specific goals, such as improving language skills or specialized knowledge for career advancement.
